question: How is this teaching both inaccessible to the Vedas and salvific for beings?
premises: The teaching is inaccessible even by the four Vedas
It delivers one across the ocean of worldly existence
These two qualities are held together
inference: Though inaccessible to the four Vedas, this teaching delivers one across the ocean of worldly existence.
plain_english: It is inaccessible by the four Vedas, yet it delivers one across the ocean of worldly existence.
